description: This file defines the Java class `ShippingQuote`, which models shipping quotation details, including options, fees, and configurations, within a shopping or e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShippingQuote
classes.description: A Java class representing a shipping quote in an e-commerce system, containing shipping options, fees, and error states.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the shipping module code identifying the shipping method.

methods.name: setShippingReturnCode
methods.description: Sets the return code indicating the status or errors related to shipping.

methods.name: setFreeShipping
methods.description: Marks the shipping as free or not.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Checks if free shipping is applicable.

methods.name: setFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount threshold for free shipping.

methods.name: getFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Gets the free shipping amount threshold.

methods.name: setHandlingFees
methods.description: Sets additional handling fees for shipping.

methods.name: setApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Configures whether tax applies to shipping costs.

methods.name: isApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Checks if tax applies to shipping.

methods.name: getQuoteError
methods.description: Gets the error message related to shipping quote, if any.

methods.name: setQuoteError
methods.description: Sets the error message related to shipping quote.
